name: statusline
description: Opt-in extra: a Claude Code status line showing model, branch, ticket and how much of the context window is used.

detect.ask: Show a status line with model, branch, ticket and context use?

statusLine.command: p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; while [ ! -f "$p/.claude/scripts/statusline.py" ] && [ "$p" != / ]; do p=$(dirname "$p"); done; python3 "$p/.claude/scripts/statusline.py"
